0.0: Oh, friend. I... have another favor. Shameless of me, I know, but do you have the time?

yes.0: I found out in my research that the nature of the Sentinels changed, after the #rtower was destroyed by an evil magician#k. I want Elder #bAlcaster#k, in #bEl Nath#k, to know. He might have answers for us.
yes.1: Deliver this #breport#k to #bAlcaster#k in #bEl Nath#k. Oh, while you're at it, please take care of the monsters below Orbis Tower 8th Floor. They've been getting in everyone's way.

no.0: Well, if you're busy, you're busy. I suppose I'll start walking down the tower again...

1.0: Welcome to El Nath. Did you... need something?

yes.0: A #breport#k, hmm? I see... Thank you for bringing this. From what I can tell, it could be related to the Black Mage's energy.\r\nBy the way, the cold in El Nath is beyond your imagination. Put this on.

0.msg: I don't think you've defeated all the monsters in the lower floors yet.

lost.0: What, you lost the report? It's okay. I have a copy.
